name: ax-income-tax
description: Prepare the 2026 individual income-tax analysis for an Åland (Aland Islands) fiscal resident. Use for Aland personal income tax, separate state and municipal deductions, the state scale reduced by 12.64 points for Åland, the 16 municipal and church rates, work-income credit, sole-trader income, health and daily-allowance contributions, the EUR 128 media fee, advance collection, residual tax, interest and filing penalties. Supplies source-linked classification rules, deduction ordering, component examples and a completion register for the reviewing practitioner. Tier 2 draft, incomplete as an operational income-tax companion: final rounding, specialist conditions, contribution bases and full settlement examples need further checks. An unresolved required source or input holds the dependent calculation and the complete financial output package.
